title: Skip API Data Upgrade During Cloud Migration

facts.text: Complete cloud migration setup and data replication before skipping API data upgrade.
Skipping API data upgrade done on per-company basis; affected API entities unavailable until upgrade completed.
Open Cloud Migration Management, select Manage API Upgrade, select company, open API Data Upgrade List in new tab, select Disable API Data Upgrades.
From on-premises upgrade, run SQL query inserting disable tag into Upgrade Tags table for single or all companies.
After going live, run API data upgrade by opening API Data Upgrade List, resetting entities with status, selecting entries, scheduling upgrades.
